variants.name: Drop
variants.summary: The drop-to-deploy confirm: New production deployment, the service with a Production `Tag`, what the files replace, and the dropped folder with its file count, total size and a scrollable list of up to 100 paths (an 'and N more' line counts the rest) with sizes formatted by `Intl.NumberFormat`. Cancel closes; Deploy to Production opens the progress dialog and starts the run.

variants.name: PartialError
variants.summary: Settled with one failure: Deployed 4 of 5 Deployment Settings with a warning `OutcomeIcon`, staging-settings marked Failed with the reason, the bar at the 4 of 5 that succeeded, Retry failed as the primary action beside an outlined Close, and no toast while the dialog shows the outcome; a run that settles while the dialog is hidden raises an error toast with Edit (reopens the dialog on the failed rows) and Redeploy.

variants.name: Success
variants.summary: Every Deployment Setting deployed: a large animated success `OutcomeIcon` beside Deployed 5 Deployment Settings, every row Done, no filter (nothing to filter), Close enabled, and no toast while the dialog shows the outcome; a run that settles while the dialog is hidden raises a success toast with Edit and Redeploy.
